V-M-TUI-RECORDS.TraceAssertion: The declared go vet command type-checks the listed packages and checks static diagnostics. No automated behavioral test coverage is declared; scenarios require manual verification.
V-M-TUI-RECORDS.Scenario: Manual check: Open help from each panel and return with any key without triggering that key's records action; preserve selection, page, scroll position, and existing errors across resizing.
Manual check: Help actions and mouse events do not mutate records or access persistence; dialog insert mode retains ? and q as text.

Manual check: Compact and wide snapshots preserve terminal modes and dialog cursors while showing only ? - help as the shortcut hint, aligned to table outer spacing, while retaining actual errors/transfer feedback.

Manual check: In three compact records panes, 1/2/3 focus sessions/performances/sets, sessions use one fifth and the right column uses the rest with an equal vertical split. Check two cells between adjacent borders and no blank rows between stacked borders. n in Performances opens the full-screen catalog. Keyboard navigation, parent filtering, counters and date-free set rows remain intact.

Manual check: Questionnaire transitions retain alternate-screen mode and records selections, pagination, scroll position, and errors; cancelling or completing skipped setup does not trigger records actions.

Manual check: s/l start asynchronous save/load only from records. Transfers prevent overlap and unsafe edits; successful restore refreshes units/data while retaining selected IDs and terminal dimensions.

Manual check: Body Weight % in workout performances and the catalog uses the same formatter for zero, fractional, and full shares; catalog edits refresh both tables. Footer wrapping accounts for shared horizontal panel spacing, and the only records shortcut text is ? - help.

V-M-TUI-HELP.Scenario: Manual check: Render titled, tab-aligned groups without a separate page title using zero vertical and one-cell horizontal outer padding, a two-cell column gap, and no extra blank rows between groups; use active-panel color for keys and inactive-border color for borderless records hints.
Manual check: At wide sizes, Navigation and Actions occupy the left column and Help begins at the top of the right column; compact widths stack Navigation, Actions and Help within bounds.

Manual check: No Pages section or 1/2/3 focus descriptions appear. Navigation shows up/down, gg first row, G last row, and enter select. Actions show exactly n new record, e edit record, d delete record, r reset setup, l load backup, and s save backup. Actual paging/focus bindings and any-key return semantics remain unchanged.

Manual check: Async authorization and saves support invalid input, failure retry, cancellation, and stale-message rejection; successful completion reformats weights without mutating the underlying domain values. ctrl+r retries with a fresh session; ctrl+o exposes the complete scrollable URL at compact sizes.

Verify full-screen catalog Enter add/select and Escape return, save-time catalog entry blocking, independent browsing, retained selected IDs, form ownership, keyboard navigation, setup/help isolation, display-only weights and bounded compact/zero-size output.

Verify catalog paging/jumps, resize with forms, compact/zero bounds, missing-session errors, no opening during transfer, and stale transfer replies preserving current view ownership.
